summary: GLM-5.3 (744B) with DCP prefills a prompt that arrives while other requests decode up to 17x faster
compatibility: No user action required. DCP_CKV_GATHER=0 turns the DCP gathers off, this one included.
details: With DCP > 1 the launcher also sets VLLM_B12X_MLA_CKV_GATHER_MIXED (vLLM #1004): batches that mix a prefill chunk with decode rows gather the compressed KV cache for their prefill rows instead of exchanging every head's queries.

TTFT of a 128K-token prompt arriving while 16 requests decode: TP8 DCP8 385.5 -> 22.9 s, TP8 DCP2 22.2 -> 18.7 s, TP6 DCP3 42.6 -> 31.6 s, TP6 DCP6 71.7 -> 32.6 s. 64 concurrent 8K prompts finish in 102 s instead of 1,333 s at TP8 DCP8, so TP8 DCP4 and DCP8 no longer prefill at about 800 tokens/s under load.
